description: This file is a CLI tool for a project initialization framework called 'universalinit'. It handles command-line arguments to create project configurations, generate template information, and retrieve run commands for various project types. The file defines functions for parsing parameters, converting template info to dictionaries, and managing output formatting, as well as a main entry point for the CLI interface.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated key=value string into a dictionary with appropriately typed values.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig for retrieving template info with default values.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path into an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary, transforming init files paths to absolute paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs the result in JSON format, indicating success or failure along with messages and template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a given project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the command to retrieve the run command for a specific project type by creating a minimal config and extracting info from the template.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: The main CLI entry point that parses arguments, handles project creation or retrieving run commands, and outputs results accordingly.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
